target.visual_information: A small square or rotated-square angle marker where two lines meet.
target.left_evidence: The small square at E between BE and the horizontal base AD.
target.right_evidence: The lower of the two tiny square marks at the central crossing of the horizontal and vertical internal lines.
target.left_meaning: BE is perpendicular to AD at E.
target.right_meaning: The intersecting horizontal and vertical internal lines are perpendicular.
target.reason: In both locations the square is attached to the angle between the intersecting lines, so the conventional symbol asserts perpendicularity. Rotation, fill and the surrounding construction do not change the right-angle meaning.
